info.title: Model Info
info.sizeUnavailable: Size unavailable — model was loaded from the OPFS cache. Reload from disk to see file size.

sizeTip.heavy: Very large file. Consider splitting the model or using LOD techniques for better performance.

elementTip.complex: Complex model. Interaction may feel slower on lower-end GPUs.
elementTip.dense: Extremely dense model. Consider LOD or splitting by discipline.

rendererTip.webgpu: WebGPU renderer active — maximum performance available on this device.
rendererTip.webgl: WebGL renderer. WebGPU is not available in this browser.

itops.label: Your office, live
itops.heroLead: What this saves you a year
itops.heroLine: Problems are spotted in {{s}} seconds, not hours. Fixed remotely, before your people notice.
itops.allOkLine: When something breaks, you will see it here first: what, where and what it costs.
itops.withoutCounting: lost so far, and nobody knows yet
itops.withWarned: warned in {{s}} s, with the exact room
itops.whileWatching_one: Saved while you watched ({{count}} problem caught)
itops.whileWatching_other: Saved while you watched ({{count}} problems caught)
itops.cta: I want this for my buildings
itops.howText: An office of {{staff}} people at {{rate}} an hour. A year: 2 server-room overheats (≈2 h with the office stopped), 12 Wi-Fi outages (one room for 1 h plus a technician visit) and 3 failed backups (a day of work redone). The live meter plays one minute per second, and the demo packs a month of problems into minutes.

overheat.title: The server room is overheating ({{value}})
overheat.impact: If it shuts down, 25 people stop working

apDown.title: A meeting room has lost its Wi-Fi

backup.title: Last night's backup failed
backup.impact: A day of work is at risk

badge.title: Someone is trying to get in without access
badge.impact: {{value}} failed attempts at the main door

live.title: Your building, telling you how it is
live.text: This is a real office in 3D. Everything that keeps it running reports in by itself every few seconds. Green means fine. Red means a problem, shown in the room where it is.

server.title: The room that can stop the whole office
server.text: The server room is at {value} °C right now. If it overheats you're warned in seconds, before 25 people are left unable to work.

wifi.title: No more “the Wi-Fi is down” calls
wifi.text: You see which room lost its connection before anyone picks up the phone, and it's fixed remotely: no technician driving over.

security.title: Security on the same screen
security.text: Someone trying the door again and again raises an alert at that door, next to the camera that sees it.

value.title: What it's worth to you
value.text: Without it, problems take hours to discover and cost lost work and call-outs. With it: 10 seconds and the exact room. About €12,000 a year per office. It runs in a browser on your existing building plans, with nothing to install.
